scope: Standing Fujiya Hotel’s main Miyanoshita hillside complex after the 2020 reopening, including the 1891 Main, Dining Room, Comfy Lodge and Restful Cottage, Flower Palace, Cascade Wing and Forest Wing.

originalReview.notes: Pixel-matched to the archive TIFF rendition. The original shows the surviving 1891 hotel’s eaves, bays and chimneys, and the earlier neighboring buildings on the hillside.
Separate period albumen print shows both octagonal bays and the carved, curved entrance canopy from the main forecourt.

quallaSearch.notes: Started with the owned Qualla media. The published Kimbei photo is a re-encoded rendition of public-domain Leiden item KITLV 110647. The 1893 gallery reproduction remains excluded because of conflicting rights on the exhibited source. The 1935 newspaper photo is an interior. Supplemental original Rijksmuseum RP-F-F01102-P is public domain and shows the same building from lower down.
